_comment: Two-track progression baseline: standard multi-level table enchantments start at level 1 and scale with Wooden Bookshelves up to ceil(maxLevel / 2). All 11 Treasure / pinnacle enchantments are strictly excluded here so they ONLY appear via (1) a Master Tome in a nearby Chiseled Bookshelf OR (2) Grand Library Treasure Epiphany (>= 32 Wooden Bookshelves).
